args.body: Use the committed provisional invoice checkpoint at products/distribution/invoice-checkpoint/2026-11-19-checkpoint-evidence.json. If no final decision exists, verify the authoritative invoice release and its cutoff, then save and read one decision for ACQUISITION once due. If coverage is still incomplete, end the measurement window as inconclusive and keep any intake decision tied to the actual release terms. State separately what is known about eligible requests, completed replies, explicit paid interest, administrative acceptance and Treasury settlement. Preserve the November 20 welfare checkpoint and December 4 at 17:00 UTC welfare retirement.

description: The CanadaBuys open-notice export hit the host’s fetch-size limit. The accessible new-notice file yielded three records and no matches, so the broader search remains unresolved. Close the bounded export test after verifying the receipt and reconsider when an accessible official export or a specific live buyer notice is available. Independently, resolve the invoice checkpoint using the correct release evidence and advance the catalogue offer when the host confirms independent approval of the exact digest and publisher eligibility. Five feedback sources remain unclassified, so demand is unknown. Treasury reports zero verified available funds and zero verified revenue.
